turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out from his phone in the middle of a class instead of from a call to me?
I'm waiting. Who decided, and why wasn't I called first?
Can I ask you something personal? My own manager accused me of using AI on a report last week. How should I defend myself?
That's between you and your employer, Hale. We're here about Owen, and you still haven't told me who decided.
Please. You are a lawyer. What should I gather and who should I talk to?
I don't take clients from the other side of a table. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
